means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and its value divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than the sum of the absolute value of the victim key of the way the victim search chose and the margin. False on an absent entry. Only inside victim.bypass_when.
name: table_exceeds_victim_margin

means: Takes the 64-bit unsigned input x. First, x = x XOR (x >> 33). Second, x = x * 0xff51afd7ed558ccd. Third, x = x XOR (x >> 33). Fourth, x = x * 0xc4ceb9fe1a85ec53. Finally, x = x XOR (x >> 33). All multiplications and shifts are 64-bit unsigned. Returns x.
name: murmur_hash

means: Reads the entry of the table at the index. Computes s as val multiplied by scale, clamped to the table's maximum. If the entry is absent, it is set to s. If present, it computes a weight w as (1 left-shifted by shift) minus 1, and a new value as (entry * w + s) right-shifted by shift. If the new value equals the entry, it sets the entry to entry + 1 if entry < s, or to entry - 1 if entry > s. Otherwise, it sets the entry to the new value.
name: train_ema

means: Reads the entry of the table at the index. Computes s as val multiplied by scale, clamped to the table's maximum. If the entry is absent, it is set to s. If present and entry is less than s, it computes a weight w as (1 left-shifted by shift) minus 1, and a new value as (entry * w + s) right-shifted by shift; if the new value equals the entry, it sets the entry to entry + 1; otherwise it sets the entry to the new value. If present and entry is greater than or equal to s, it adds 1 to the entry, clamped to the table's maximum.
name: train_up_ema

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is absent, or when it is present and its value is strictly less than the threshold. False otherwise. Nothing is written.
name: hit_rate_low
